title: Governor's Honors Academy
who_text: West Virginia high school juniors who live in the state, with at least a 3.5 GPA or a top 10 percent class rank and no grades below a C
description: A three-week live-in summer program at West Virginia University for about 175 strong students. State funds pay for tuition, room, board, and class materials. Your application goes through your county superintendent.

title: Governor's School for the Arts
who_text: West Virginia high school sophomores who live in the state and have at least a 2.2 GPA; an audition is required
description: A free three-week live-in summer program for young artists, held in 2026 at West Virginia Wesleyan College. You study one area such as creative writing, dance, music, painting and drawing, theater, or digital literacy.

title: Governor's Computer Science Institute
who_text: West Virginia residents in 9th or 10th grade at a West Virginia high school, with at least a 3.0 GPA and a principal recommendation
description: A free one-week summer program at WVU Tech in Beckley. You practice coding and programming to solve real problems and work in teams like computer scientists do.

title: Governor's School of Entrepreneurship
who_text: West Virginia residents in 9th, 10th, or 11th grade at a West Virginia high school, with at least a 2.5 GPA, a principal recommendation, and two teacher recommendations
description: A free 10-day summer program held in 2026 at Marshall University. You work with other students to build a startup idea, learn from business experts, and pitch your idea to investors.
